scenarios.title: A｜认识主人
scenarios.setting: 玩家被朋友带到一个自己不认识主人的聚会。

turns.text: Oh, there’s Sam. He’s the one hosting the party. Let me introduce you.
Hey! You must be Alex. Jamie told me you were coming.

turns.prompt: 你想确认信息或告诉对方已经完成，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, that’s me. Nice to meet you, and thanks for having me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s me. Nice to meet you, and thanks for having me.
feedback.explanation: “thanks for having me”感谢对方邀请或招待自己，适合做客后的告别。

choices.text: Nice to meet you! Thanks for inviting me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Nice to meet you! Thanks for inviting me.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Hi! Jamie’s told me a little about you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi! Jamie’s told me a little about you.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: Your place is really nice. Thanks for having us.

feedback.naturalExpression: Your place is really nice. Thanks for having us.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Thanks for letting me come to your party.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s me. Nice to meet you, and thanks for having me.
feedback.explanation: “letting me come”像在感谢被允许参加；“Thanks for inviting me”更直接感谢邀请。

turns.text: Of course! Make yourself at home. Drinks are in the kitchen.

turns.prompt: 你想询问外套或随身物品可以放在哪里，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great, thanks. Can I put my coat somewhere?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thanks. Can I put my coat somewhere?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Thanks! Is there somewhere I can leave my bag?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks! Is there somewhere I can leave my bag?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Perfect. Do you need any help with anything?

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Do you need any help with anything?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

turns.text: You can leave your coat in the bedroom. And no, just enjoy yourself.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Will do. Thanks again!

feedback.naturalExpression: Will do. Thanks again!
feedback.explanation: “will do”简短表示会照办，适合接到明确任务后回应。

choices.text: Sounds good. I’m going to grab a drink, then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sounds good. I’m going to grab a drink, then.
feedback.explanation: “I’m going to”说明计划或去向，能让对方知道接下来的安排。

scenarios.title: B｜不认识其他人
scenarios.setting: 带玩家来的朋友暂时离开，玩家发现周围一个人都不认识。

turns.text: I’m going to help Sam in the kitchen for a minute. You’ll be okay?

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, of course. Go ahead.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, of course. Go ahead.
feedback.explanation: “go ahead”表示请继续或可以开始，让对方知道自己准备好了。

choices.text: Sure. I’ll try to meet some people.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I’ll try to meet some people.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Yeah, don’t worry about me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, don’t worry about me.
feedback.explanation: 明确说出担心之处，方便对方针对顾虑解释；没有把担心直接说成已发生的事实。

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, I’m Alex. I don’t think we’ve met.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, I’m Alex. I don’t think we’ve met.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: Hi. Do you know Sam?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. Do you know Sam?
feedback.explanation: 询问对方是否掌握所需信息，也给“不清楚”留出回答空间。

choices.text: Hey. How do you know everyone here?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey. How do you know everyone here?
feedback.explanation: 询问对方是否掌握所需信息，也给“不清楚”留出回答空间。

choices.text: Hi, I’m Alex. Is this your first time meeting most of these people too?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m Alex. Is this your first time meeting most of these people too?
feedback.explanation: “first time”说明是第一次经历这件事，适合回答是否熟悉场所或活动。

choices.text: Hello. I don’t know anybody here.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, I’m Alex. I don’t think we’ve met.
feedback.explanation: 这句真实，但突然说谁都不认识略突兀；先自报姓名，再问对方怎么认识主人，更容易开启聊天。

turns.text: I’m Taylor. I work with Sam. How do you know him?

turns.prompt: 关于「到达陌生聚会」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I actually don’t know him very well. I came with Jamie.

feedback.naturalExpression: I actually don’t know him very well. I came with Jamie.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: Jamie invited me. She’s a friend of mine.

feedback.naturalExpression: Jamie invited me. She’s a friend of mine.
feedback.explanation: 先说谁邀请自己，再说明朋友关系，回答了与主人的联系。

choices.text: I’m here with Jamie. I think she knows Sam from work.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m here with Jamie. I think she knows Sam from work.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.text: Ah, okay. I know Jamie too.

turns.prompt: 你想通过彼此共同认识的人自然展开聊天，会怎么说？

choices.text: Oh, nice! How do you two know each other?

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, nice! How do you two know each other?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Well, at least I know one more person now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Well, at least I know one more person now.
feedback.explanation: “one more person”承接刚认识对方，用轻松的积极回应延续初次见面的聊天。

choices.text: Small world!

feedback.naturalExpression: Small world!
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

scenarios.title: C｜加入一群人的聊天
scenarios.setting: 玩家看到几个人正在聊天，想自然加入。

turns.text: …and then we realized we’d been waiting at the wrong station the whole time.

turns.prompt: 你想自然加入谈话，了解刚才发生了什么，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sorry, I couldn’t help overhearing—what happened?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I couldn’t help overhearing—what happened?
feedback.explanation: “Sorry”可用于礼貌打断或引出更正，后面的具体内容让对方知道需要回应哪一点。

choices.text: Wait, you were at the wrong station?

feedback.naturalExpression: Wait, you were at the wrong station?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: That sounds like there’s a story behind it.

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds like there’s a story behind it.
feedback.explanation: “sounds like”表示根据对方的描述形成的印象，不是声称自己已经直接了解全部情况。

choices.text: Mind if I join you guys?

feedback.naturalExpression: Mind if I join you guys?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: What are you guys talking about?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I couldn’t help overhearing—what happened?
feedback.explanation: 这句可以加入话题；突然插话时先打招呼或问能否加入，会更容易被接纳。

turns.text: We were just talking about travel disasters. Have you ever had one?

turns.prompt: 关于「到达陌生聚会」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Oh, definitely. I once got on the wrong train in a city I’d never been to before.

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, definitely. I once got on the wrong train in a city I’d never been to before.
feedback.explanation: 用一次坐错车的经历回应话题，让闲聊从泛泛评价进入具体故事。

choices.text: Nothing that bad, but I’ve missed a flight before.

feedback.naturalExpression: Nothing that bad, but I’ve missed a flight before.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: Thankfully, no. But I’ve come pretty close a few times.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thankfully, no. But I’ve come pretty close a few times.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

choices.text: Does getting completely lost for three hours count?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does getting completely lost for three hours count?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

turns.prompt: 你想解释当时遇到的手机和语言困难，会怎么说？

choices.text: My phone died, and I didn’t know enough of the language to ask for directions.

feedback.naturalExpression: My phone died, and I didn’t know enough of the language to ask for directions.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: It’s a long story, but basically everything that could go wrong went wrong.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a long story, but basically everything that could go wrong went wrong.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: I kept thinking I was going the right way. I definitely wasn’t.

feedback.naturalExpression: I kept thinking I was going the right way. I definitely wasn’t.
feedback.explanation: 对照当时以为走对和实际走错，带出轻松的自嘲。

turns.prompt: 你想表达认同或相似的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: Not exactly the kind of competition I wanted to win!

feedback.naturalExpression: Not exactly the kind of competition I wanted to win!
feedback.explanation: “I wanted to”在提出请求或话题时常用于缓和语气，不一定只指过去的愿望。

choices.text: At least it’s funny now. It definitely wasn’t funny at the time.

feedback.naturalExpression: At least it’s funny now. It definitely wasn’t funny at the time.
feedback.explanation: “at least”表示最低数量或程度，能说明可接受的下限。

choices.text: Yeah, I learned to carry a power bank after that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I learned to carry a power bank after that.
feedback.explanation: “power bank”指充电宝，指可随身携带的外部电源。
